methodHandling.otherMethods: Only DELETE is distinguished; EVERY other method (POST, PUT, PATCH, HEAD...) is handled as GET (list or single deck). Body never read.

query.name: id
query.invalidBehaviour: DELETE without id -> 400 'id required'. Non-UUID id -> Postgres invalid-uuid error -> 500 'Internal error' (GET single and DELETE). GET with empty id (?id=) is treated as absent -> list.

bodyShape.decks: [{id, title, status ('draft'|'generating'|'done'|'failed'), created_at}] ordered created_at desc; [] when none

responses.when: GET with id of an owned deck

bodyShape.deck: the full decks row (select *): id, owner, title, inputs (verbatim client inputs jsonb), storyline (jsonb), status, created_at, updated_at, plus analytics columns added by later migrations (e.g. slide_count, brand_id, creation_method, generation_started_at)
bodyShape.slides: full slides rows (select *) ordered by number: id, deck_id, number, title, framework, description, bullets, prompt, variant_a_blob_key, variant_b_blob_key, variant_a_status, variant_b_status, variant_a_error, variant_b_error (+ later columns), plus `type` folded in from deck.storyline when the storyline has a string type for that number

responses.when: DELETE with id (owned, foreign or non-existent — idempotent no-op)

errors.when: GET id not owned or missing

sideEffects: DELETE: decks row delete (owner-scoped); slides cascade; blobs (images, job state) are left in place (_shared/db.ts:146-149; openapi.yaml:1585-1600)
quirks: DELETE of a foreign or missing deck returns 200 {ok:true} (no 404/403).

Single-deck response exposes raw DB column names (variant_a_*), including legacy variant_b_* columns, and every column added by future migrations — snapshot must allow column additions or pin the exact current set.
Slide `type` is not a DB column; it is merged from the storyline and absent when the storyline lacks it.
beforeAnyState: GET list for a new user -> 200 {"decks":[]}.

tests.asserts: list without id; single deck with slides (deck.id); 404 for missing/foreign (lines 19-39). No DELETE test.

docs.openapi: public/openapi.yaml:1520-1601 — GET/DELETE documented and consistent; deck.storyline is typed as StorylineResponse but the stored storyline has no `inputs`/`warnings` (it is the repaired Storyline); slides items untyped; 400/404 undocumented.
docs.postman: '6 · Deck Management' has GET list and GET single only; DELETE absent.

planSection65: Row 'GET → {decks}; ?id= → deck; DELETE ?id= → {ok:true}' — accurate; '?id= → deck' is precisely {deck, slides}.
